notes.title: Kickstarter Funded!
notes.content:
On March 16th we launched a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ghostbros/ghost-bros]Kickstarter[/url] to help us cover server costs while we enter Alpha and then Beta testing.  Our goal was surpassed within two days.  Soon we had passed our first stretch goal, and now we are nearing our second!  With this first stretch goal we are able to add more features to the game:

[list]
[*] A cat companion who assists on investigations (with an exclusive Kickstarter skin for all backers).
[*] More accessibility options, something we are very excited about!
[*] More historical locations.  These will be specially designed to imitate real life haunted locations.
[/list]

Thank you all so much for your support and we are so excited to add more to this game than we would have been able to on our own!

We will be bug testing the Pre-Alpha version of Ghost Bros on the [url=https://Twitch.tv/PlayguePals]PlayguePals Twitch channel[/url] March 30th, 5pm Pacific (PDT), and we will have game content updates on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@PlayguePals]PlayguePals YouTube channel[/url]!

Also, we made a new teaser:
[previewyoutube=pmNUkoTw4EA;full][/previewyoutube]
